hudu.description: AI-powered odd-job marketplace built with React Native — list projects, receive bids, chat, and pay through escrow.

Built and maintained as a large React Native application with performance-focused UI and API integrations.

compressa.title: Compressa | فشرده‌یار
compressa.description: Kotlin Android app for compressing images, video, and PDF with Jetpack Compose and clean architecture.
compressa.longDescription: Compressa (فشرده‌یار) is an Android media compression app built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. It supports image, video, and PDF compression, multi-select queues with a foreground service, before/after results, history, duplicate scanning, and large-file scanning — with Persian/English and RTL/LTR.

features.0: Image, video, and PDF compression engines
features.1: Compression queue with foreground service and progress
features.2: Before/after results, history, and media viewer
features.3: Duplicate and large-file scanners with Persian/English RTL/LTR

compressa.architecture: Clean feature modules with Compose UI, use cases, media engines, DataStore preferences, and SQLite history.
